classes.name: EqualsOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'equals' comparison operator used in JSON API filters, extending the generic Operator class and implementing OperatorInterface.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the filter operator, in this case 'eq'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator for equality, which is '='.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and adheres to the parent class's validation rules.
